scope: Administrative transmission and archival survival states relevant to the 1825/1830 Hodgson-military classification problem.
central_claim: Military classification moved through parallel administrative record channels. The identified surviving London witness of the Bengal Military letter of 6 Nov 1830, IOR/L/MIL/3/32 no.52, belongs to the Board of Control copy series. Later archival weeding preferentially retained this pre-1858 Board-copy branch over duplicated Company holdings.
